capabilities: Add cover banner images to notes with crop, height, parallax and dimming controls
Auto-set covers from note URLs, YouTube thumbnails, page preview images, or Google Books
Set note icons from emoji, Iconify, favicons, or local images
Choose content and code fonts and reading templates
Hide rendered properties and note titles without editing frontmatter
disambiguation: Not only cover images; it also restyles Markdown, code, JSON and LaTeX rendering and bundles reading fonts and templates.
extras: Ships its own automatic updater that checks the author's GitHub repository every six hours and installs releases outside Obsidian's normal plugin update flow; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents which network requests the plugin makes and includes troubleshooting.
intentEvidence: Notes written for the Banners plugin by noatpad (MIT) work without changes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to give notes decorative cover images, title icons, or tuned reading typography.
